newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo gold futures end mixed, off early lows.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo gold futures end mixed, off early lows.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo gold futures reversed their early losses to end narrowly mixed on Tuesday as spot gold rebounded from early lows, traders said.
Gold futures ranged from one yen per gram lower to four yen firmer. Benchmark October was one yen lower at 1,338 yen.

In the bullion market, spot gold was quoted at $368.60/90 per ounce at the Tokyo close after touching $367.90, the lowest level seen since April 1994. "Spot gold recovered from early lows as buying by overseas investors emerged in the afternoon. But sentiment remained bearish, with gold expected to eventually test $360," one trader said.
